protocol_criterion: Intervenable pool S must contain >=5 CRISPR KO targets among the selected locked genes (PREREG-DRAFT §1.3 / FIREWALL-CERTIFICATION-PACKET §1.3).
reason: The GSE90063 sample GSM2396858_k562_tfs_7 profiled transcription-factor knock-outs. None of the 10 KO targets overlap the alphabetically-locked KEGG p53 signaling pathway genes. Without pathway-internal interventions, the held-out intervention protocol cannot be constructed, and the Stage 4 fresh-domain test cannot proceed under the pre-registered design.

Switch to a whole-genome Perturb-seq dataset where many genes are knocked out (e.g., Replogle et al. 2022, GSE190604) and keep the p53 pathway lock.
Declare Stage 4 not executable with this data/sample/lock combination and record the honest negative, as done here.
note: This is an honest negative: the data were downloaded and inspected under the locked protocol, and the failure is reported rather than patched by changing the pathway or sample post hoc.
